A1.claim_allowed: Under POA+GHI only, the eight-plant G3 cohort still exhibits residual plant-balanced OTG, directional asymmetry, and a positive same-state control-minus-twin contrast; G3 is not pooled with primary RQ1–RQ3.
A1.claim_prohibited: Do not treat G3 headlines as interchangeable with primary estimates or as a six-feature replication.
A1.estimated_footprint: Methods 1 sentence + Results 1 short paragraph (~8–12 lines). No new figure.
A1.insertion_location: Methods surrogate paragraph (feature-set note) and a new Results sensitivity paragraph after RQ2; Table I status can stay 'sensitivity, reduced features'.
A1.scientific_rationale: Table I already flags G3 as excluded for reduced features; a short sensitivity result answers whether residual OTG is an artifact of the six-feature primary cohort.
A1.selection_basis: reviewer-likely gap in Table I, not proximity of G3 RQ1 to primary RQ1

A2.claim_allowed: Broadening from one matched control per target to all structurally executable same-state non-twins (median 2 per target; 12 distinct controls; 118 comparisons) yields a target-balanced CONTROL_MINUS_TWIN contrast of the same sign as primary RQ3.
A2.claim_prohibited: Do not present R8 as a replacement primary estimand, a p-value, or evidence that more controls make twins universally better.
A2.estimated_footprint: Results 1–2 sentences and optional Table II row (~4–6 lines). No new figure.
A2.insertion_location: RQ3 results after the three-control sentence; optional robustness table row labeled R8 descriptive.
A2.scientific_rationale: The manuscript already discloses that revised RQ3 uses only three distinct controls; R8 tests whether the twin-vs-control signal survives the full structurally executable same-state control set.
A2.selection_basis: addresses an existing limitation, not that R8 is larger than primary RQ3

A3.claim_allowed: Within G2, source choice was consequential: among its ten targets with at least two computable twin sources, the median gap between the best and worst source was 0.1057 normalized MAE (maximum 0.1315).
A3.claim_prohibited: Do not generalize source-choice spread to G1/G4 or to the secondary RQ4 deployment analysis.
A3.estimated_footprint: One Results sentence (~2–3 lines) near the G2 operational-twin map. No separate figure.
A3.insertion_location: RQ1 paragraph on the G2 map (Fig. 2).
A3.scientific_rationale: User editorial decision after the Phase 4 synthesis: place the G2 source-choice spread statistic in the main text next to Fig. 2, with the G2-only scope preserved.
A3.selection_basis: user editorial decision after scientific synthesis; not result sign/magnitude and not page budget

A4.claim_allowed: Group-level plant-balanced OTG varied from −0.0089 (G4) to 0.0152 (G2), with G1 near zero (0.0011).
A4.claim_prohibited: Do not read A4 as within-group source-choice variation or as evidence that G4 twins are interchangeable.
A4.estimated_footprint: One Results sentence (~2 lines) adjacent to the RQ1 headline or G2-map discussion. No separate figure.
A4.insertion_location: RQ1 after the plant-balanced headline, or adjacent to the G2-map discussion.
A4.scientific_rationale: User editorial decision after the Phase 4 synthesis: state between-group plant-balanced OTG heterogeneity in the main RQ1 results.
A4.selection_basis: user editorial decision after scientific synthesis; includes the negative G4 mean rather than selecting on sign

beyond_paper_a.A1_generality: Same qualitative OTG/asymmetry/control-minus-twin pattern appears in a reduced-feature G3 cohort that the paper currently only excludes.
beyond_paper_a.A2_control_robustness: Twin-vs-control is not an artifact of one matched control; executable-control expansion keeps a positive target-balanced contrast.
beyond_paper_a.A3_source_identity: Inside G2, best-vs-worst twin source OTG spread is large; this is already qualitatively visible in Fig. 2.
beyond_paper_a.A4_group_heterogeneity: Primary group means span negative to positive OTG, so the plant-balanced headline is not a homogeneous twin-group property.
